page_title: AUG 1-2 UNI | Augsburg v Union Berlin 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Referee Felix Brych signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Union Berlin players have a reason to celebrate!
90+5' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Felix Brych is going to take a look using VAR.

90+4' 1 - 2 GOAL! A great pass finds Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from close range. It’s now 1:2.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Augsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' A substitution has been made. Benedict Hollerbach goes off and Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) comes on.
87' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.
83' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) commits a foul and Felix Brych immediately signals a free kick.
80' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Tim Skarke and he is replaced by Marin Ljubicic (Union Berlin).
80' The substitution is prepared. Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Cedric Zesiger.
80' Substitution. Frank Onyeka walks off the pitch and Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.

78' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Alexander Schwolow is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
74' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post.
71' Jess Thorup decides to make a substitution. Mert Komur will be replaced by Steve Mounie (Augsburg).
69' 1 - 1 Goal! Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:1.
63' Augsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
61' Substitution. Andras Schafer leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin).
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) coming on for David Preu.
61' Steffen Baumgart prepares a substitution. Josip Juranovic is replaced by Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin).
59' Jess Thorup has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arne Maier (Augsburg) replacing Alexis Claude-Maurice.
59' Here comes a substitution. Marius Wolf is given a rest as he is replaced by Robert Gumny (Augsburg).
57' A wild pass somehow finds Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
53' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
49' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Felix Brych no option but to blow his whistle.
47' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
46' Referee Felix Brych blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Augsburg was in an offside position.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

43' Nice move, nice attempt! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
41' 1 - 0 Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
40' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) makes a strong challenge and Felix Brych blows for a foul.
37' An attempted cross from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is cleared.
35' What an opportunity! Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
34' Mert Komur (Augsburg) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
33' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar.
30' Great teamplay by Augsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
23' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) commits a rough challenge and Felix Brych blows his whistle for an infringement.
22' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
17' Augsburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
14' Rough tackle by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
10' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) tackles a bit over-zealously and Felix Brych blows for a foul.

8' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
7' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

7' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Alexander Schwolow dived superbly to block a header by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the roof of the net, but Alexander Schwolow pulled off a remarkable save! The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Augsburg.
4' The linesman raises his flag. Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is adjudged offside.
3' Felix Brych blows his whistle after Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.

1' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) has a big opportunity! He finds some space for a shot inside the penalty box after collecting a lofted pass and sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Felix Brych will referee today's match.
